title: 05. Two Eyes & Life/Death (22k–19k)
description: A group needs two separate eyes to live permanently. Find the vital point to make two eyes or destroy the opponent's eyes.

puzzles.title: Make Two Eyes on the Edge
puzzles.prompt: Black's corner group is surrounded by White. Play the vital point inside to split the space into two separate eyes.

solutions.feedback: Alive! B1 divides your inner pocket into two separate single-point eyes at A1 and B2—White can never legally capture this group.
Alive! B2 divides your inner pocket into two separate eyes at A2 and B1.

wrongHints.default: Play in the middle of your 3-space pocket (B1 or B2) so it splits into two separate eyes that White cannot fill simultaneously.

puzzles.title: Kill the Opponent's Eye Shape
puzzles.prompt: White's corner group has a 3-space eye pocket. Strike the vital point before White makes two eyes!

solutions.feedback: Vital point! Occupying H8 reduces White to at most one eye—the entire corner group is dead.

wrongHints.default: The enemy's vital point is my vital point: play at H8 right in the center of White's 3-point eye space.

puzzles.title: Fix the False Eye!
puzzles.concept: A False Eye has an enemy stone controlling its diagonal corner—meaning the enemy can put your wall in Atari and force you to fill your own eye.
puzzles.prompt: Black has one real eye at A1, but B3 is a FALSE eye because White threatens C4! Connect at C4 to turn B3 into a real second eye!

solutions.feedback: Saved! Connecting at C4 unifies your A4-B4 stones with C3-C2-C1, turning B3 into a genuine second eye!

wrongHints.default: Look at the diagonal gap between B4 and C3—if White plays C4, your A4-B4 stones go into Atari and B3 collapses! Connect at C4.

puzzles.title: Pyramid Four (Nakade Vital Point)
puzzles.concept: A T-shaped 4-space pocket only lives if the defender holds the center intersection—if the attacker takes that center point first, the group dies.
puzzles.prompt: White's corner group has a T-shaped 4-space pocket (H9, G8, H8, J8). Strike the single vital point in the center of the T!

solutions.feedback: Bullseye! H8 is the heart of the T-shape—White is left with three disconnected corners and cannot form two eyes.

wrongHints.default: Find the intersection touching all three branches of White's T-pocket (H9, G8, and J8)—strike H8!

puzzles.title: Expand Eye Space Before Closing
puzzles.concept: A 2-space pocket in the corner is dead unless you expand it to 3 spaces along the edge first.
puzzles.prompt: Black's corner group is surrounded by White on the outside, with open edge space at D1. Expand your eye space to survive!

solutions.feedback: Alive! Descending to D1 creates a 3-space pocket (A1, B1, C1) so White can never stop you from playing B1 for two eyes!

wrongHints.default: If White plays D1 first, your inner pocket shrinks to 2 spaces (A1-B1) which is only 1 eye! Descend to D1 immediately.

puzzles.title: 2-Step Corner Kill
puzzles.concept: Reduce the enemy's eye space from the outside first, then finish the capture on the edge.
puzzles.prompt: White's bottom-right corner isn't completely sealed yet. Shrink White's eye space from the outside first!

steps.feedback: Step 1 complete! Pushing at J2 removes White's outer eye—White blocks at H1. Now deliver the lethal blow!
Step 2 complete! J1 puts the entire corner group in Atari with only 1 eye—White is captured!

wrongHints.default: Throw in on the right edge at J2 first to shrink White's pocket, then finish at J1.
